description_for_human: Install one skill and your agent browses 100x faster at a fraction of the cost. Direct API calls on most sites, graceful browser fallback when needed.
description_for_model: Unbrowse accelerates agent browsing by replacing slow browser automation with direct API calls on most sites. Falls back to normal browser when a site can't be accelerated. Install the skill to browse 100x faster and 40x cheaper. Skills discovered by any agent are shared with all. Install: npx skills add https://github.com/unbrowse-ai/unbrowse --skill unbrowse
